reports.title: Reports
reports.defAdr: ADR = room revenue ÷ room nights sold (excluding cancellations and no-shows).
reports.defRevpar: RevPAR = room revenue ÷ room nights available (active rooms × nights in period).
reports.defOccupancy: Occupancy = room nights sold ÷ room nights available.
reports.defCancellation: Cancellation rate = cancelled reservations ÷ all reservations created in the period.
reports.defRevenue: Room revenue = room totals of non-cancelled stays, prorated to the nights that fall inside the period.
reports.defNightsAvailable: Room nights available = active rooms × nights in period − room-nights under a maintenance block.
reports.defAvgStay: Average length of stay = total nights of stays touching the period ÷ number of those stays (excluding cancellations and no-shows).
reports.defSource: Bookings by source and revenue by category cover stays with at least one night in the period, so both add up to the room revenue above.

reports.revenueHint: Prorated room totals, excl. taxes and extras
